coverage_rule: Every path in the current inventory matches exactly one most-specific zone. A zone is a navigation classification, never an admission or runtime status grant.

zones.status_route: Resolve current_lookup, exact entry lifecycle_state, and admission_decision_ref.

zones.role: Definition construction and admitted source lineage
zones.status_route: Use the live Definition registry; candidate package status alone is not effective admission.

zones.role: Definition index, drift audits, and governance support
zones.status_route: Follow the live registry for meanings and decisions for effects; indexes are projections.

zones.role: exact admitted bundles, overlays, registries, and preserved source copies
zones.status_route: Read bundle, matching admission overlay, decision, authorization, and receipt; copied candidate fields remain provenance.
Resolve effective contract in the admitted D72 Artifact Type registry or applicable admission overlay.
Read exact admission overlay and decision; do not infer instance admission.

zones.role: versioned carrier contracts, schemas, fixtures, and receipts
zones.status_route: Resolve effective contract in the D72 Artifact Type registry; source files and validation receipts alone are not admission.

zones.role: closed relation axes, endpoint pairs, qualifiers, and source instances
zones.status_route: Resolve Relation Kind state in the D70 effective registry and Typed Relation instance state in exact overlays.
Check the exact profile admission or decision; a file path is not a current-state assertion.
Read the exact migration registry and source-admission decision; contract selection does not activate a consumer.
Read exact owner record and decision scope; owner labels alone do not authorize operations.
Check source selection and digest; lineage does not transfer authority.
Read the exact foundation decision and scope before inferring any later effect.
Separate selected Product context from adoption, activation, and runtime realization.
Use D71 admission overlays for effective instance and relation status.

zones.role: source candidates for D72 Project State bootstrap
zones.status_route: Use D72 admission overlays and event-history instances for effective state.

zones.role: integrated ontology model contracts and candidates
zones.status_route: Resolve exact model admission and distinguish model semantics from runtime projection.
Use exact artifact and relation instance admission overlays; pack validation is not admission.

zones.role: candidate Agent work episode and context material
zones.status_route: Resolve Agent and session boundaries through exact candidate or admission records; a build script does not establish an active Agent or durable memory.

zones.role: candidate governance composition and read models
zones.status_route: Candidate only until a separately authorized admission; generated views have no authority effect.

zones.role: decision, authorization, proposal, and application evidence
zones.status_route: Read each decision's exact status and effect plus authorization and application receipt; folder presence is insufficient.

zones.role: plans, proposals, packs, and explanatory records
zones.status_route: Follow the specific decision or registry named by each document; plan and proposal do not imply execution.

zones.role: migration source reconstruction and candidate evidence
zones.status_route: Trace exact selected source and admission; candidate validation is not migration execution.

zones.role: bounded migration execution receipts and observed outcomes
zones.status_route: Read each execution receipt and claim ceiling; one execution does not prove whole migration completion.
Check exact source, selected bytes, receipt, and decision before use as authority.
Validation proves only exercised checks on bound bytes; it is not admission or activation.
Read exact conformance scope and evidence freshness; do not infer runtime state.
Resolve corresponding adoption, validation, and runtime decision; implementation presence is not activation.
Treat research as candidate knowledge until exact evidence assessment and decision.

zones.role: Craft architecture, capabilities, ontology, definitions, and supporting source
zones.status_route: Check specific admission and implementation binding; Craft source is not automatically canonical Lab authority.
Read candidate and product decisions; do not infer live cutover.
Read the local runtime decision and current conformance/activation records; a build is not live operation.
Check authorization, prerequisites, execution receipt, and rollback evidence for the exact operation.

zones.role: ontology definitions, sources, projections, fixtures, conformance, and migration
zones.status_route: Distinguish candidate witness, product approval, local runtime activation, migration, and live cutover by exact decision.
Read binding and its admission/adoption decision; a binding does not prove execution or effectiveness.

zones.role: Product definitions, selected models, and prototypes
zones.status_route: Separate Product identity, thesis, capability, realization, adoption, activation, and execution.

zones.role: context definitions, maps, and bounded projections
zones.status_route: Resolve context contract and exact source cursor; a context view does not become Project memory or ontology truth.
Read each exact goal and project relation; membership and goal coordination do not imply authority.
Test source and results support bounded evidence only; a test file is not a passing result.

zones.role: generators, importers, validators, schemas, and inventory tools
zones.status_route: Tool output inherits source-bound claim limits; code presence is not execution.

zones.role: generated path/content index and source-linked navigation
zones.status_route: Derived non-authority lookup; refresh before relying on coverage or digests.
Use admitted definitions and ontology contracts for effective meaning; notes are not promotion.
Context material is not an admission or decision.

zones.role: root foundation text and repository metadata
zones.status_route: Use exact decisions and registries for effects; root files alone do not assert current admission.

integration_edges.meaning: source reconstruction feeds bounded Definition candidates
closed kinds constrain admitted Typed Relation instances
exact owner decisions and authorization bind admission effects
D71 admitted exact foundation source copies through instance and relation overlays
D72 admitted Project event histories and the first successor state
admitted Project State can be selected into bounded context views only through an explicit projection
semantic and governance histories can support source-bound ontology projections under their own contracts
ontology candidate implementation produces bounded validation and conformance evidence
path-complete non-authority inventory supplies file coverage to the governance read model

claim_ceiling: Path-complete navigation classification over the inventory selection and source-linked integration map. It does not assess every file's semantic status, admit any subject, create a Typed Relation, or activate a consumer or runtime.
